notes:
The course workstream is finished. The earlier paused run had already built most of it, and I kept that work: the import.meta.glob lesson registry, the 8-stage catalogue and course map, the lesson player with deep links and keyboard steps, renderers for all 14 block kinds, ContinueLessonCard, marks.ts (resolveMarks), validate.ts with its tests, i18n, and the fixture lesson (tests/course/fixtures/example-lesson.ts). This run tested that code against the real synth, practice and real-case modules for the first time and fixed what broke.

Fixed or added in this run:
1. Live-block bug: the first tracing was generated without dials, so `applied` was empty. The sliders then sat at the middle of their range and the read-out showed, for example, 80 bpm while the strip was at 72. Now src/course/live.ts takes start values from the scenario as written (rate, HRV, ST, T amplitude, voltage, QTc, AF coarseness), or the middle of the range, and the first tracing is generated with those values. The read-outs show the values the engine applied. Dials the engine ignores for that scenario are not offered as sliders. Voltage and noise units now match src/synth/dials (× and mV); before, voltage used 1 mm steps on a 0.3–2 range.
2. Heart Lab links: lessons link into the Heart Lab with labHref (src/course/lab.ts, importing src/lab/links.ts so no lab engine code is loaded). There is one link per lab scenario among the lesson's findings, in the lesson footer. A link appears only when the shell routes it; #/lab is now routed. The Spanish title uses the shell's name, 'Laboratorio cardiaco'.
3. The drill mastery bar uses per-family mastery when practice offers it.
4. The course map shows 'lessons are being written' when no lesson is ready yet, instead of '0 of 0'.
5. The 'question could not be loaded' message is now neutral, since the practice module exists.
6. wireCourse() is exported from src/course/index.tsx.
7. LessonPlayer is exported from LessonPage.tsx for the dev harness only.
